## What you should be able to do tonight

- Publish the dossier, the unadjusted track record and the retrospective as one set.
- State what you would do with the next 365 hours, with the same time budget honesty this year was built on.

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
The system that started as an empty DuckDB file on day 20 now ingests, forecasts, sizes, executes, reconciles and reports on a schedule, with a track record it did not tamper with and a written account of everything it still gets wrong.
:::
